clips.text_zh: Retard Fatigue。我係未來穿越者。今次係gold嘅底。10月31日，Trump同Benny會炸島。Iran War完，oil會回落$50，gold同silver由2027年1月31日起升。截圖保存。
clips.text_en_b1: Retard Fatigue. I am a time traveler from the future. This is the bottom for gold. On October 31, Trump and Benny will bomb the island. The Iran War will end, oil will go back to $50, and gold and silver will start shooting up on January 31, 2027. Screenshot this.
clips.source_hint: An anonymous time traveler claims to know the exact gold and oil turning points.

signal.rationale: The post confidently predicts gold and silver will rally from the stated bottom.

clips.text_en_b2: Retard Fatigue. Coming through as a time traveller from the future, and this is where gold bottoms out. On October 31, Trump and Benny will bomb the island, which brings the Iran War to an end and pushes oil back down to $50. From January 31, 2027, gold and silver start shooting up like nobody has seen before. Better take a screenshot while you still can.
clips.text_en_c1: Retard Fatigue: I am a traveller from the future, and this is where gold bottoms out. On October 31, Trump and Benny will bomb the island. Once the Iran War is over, oil will fall back to $50, after which both gold and silver will begin rising sharply from January 31, 2027. If this prediction comes true, the people who dismissed it will no longer be able to claim that they were simply waiting for a better entry point. Take a screenshot now, because you will want to preserve the evidence.
clips.text_en_c2: Retard Fatigue. Allow me to present irrefutable evidence from the future: gold has finally reached its bottom. On October 31, Trump and Benny will bomb the island; once the Iran War ends, oil will retreat to $50. From January 31, 2027, gold and silver will begin shooting upwards with renewed conviction. Whether this prediction proves accurate or spectacularly wrong, history will judge the call. For now, preserve the screenshot, because the timeline is about to become considerably more interesting.

clips.text_zh: 講真，今次唔係shitpost。Bitcoin係escape AI嘅liferaft。Satoshi Nakamoto可能同CIA有關。2020年3月$3,000，到2024年12月over $100,000，4.5年。大家都miss咗，反而追住dollars走。
clips.text_en_b1: This will sound like a shitpost, but it is not. It was Bitcoin. Bitcoin was the life raft to escape AI. Satoshi Nakamoto, Central Intelligence. We were given over 12 years to accumulate at low prices. It took off from 3K to 108K between March 2020 and December 2024. Everyone failed by chasing dollars instead of holding BTC.
clips.source_hint: The poster argues Bitcoin was the real escape from AI and urges holding instead of chasing dollars.

signal.rationale: The post presents Bitcoin as a long-term accumulation asset rather than a short-term trade.

clips.text_en_b2: This might sound like a shitpost, but it genuinely is not. It was Bitcoin all along, serving as the life raft that let us escape AI. Satoshi Nakamoto, Central Intelligence. We were handed over twelve years to accumulate at low prices, and between March 2020 and December 2024 it took off from 3K to 108K. Yet everyone still failed, chasing dollars instead of holding BTC.
clips.text_en_c1: This will sound like a shitpost, but it is not: Bitcoin was the lifeboat that enabled us to escape AI. Satoshi Nakamoto may have been connected to the CIA. We were handed more than twelve years to accumulate Bitcoin at relatively low prices, yet most of us missed the opportunity. From March 2020 to December 2024, it surged from $3,000 to $108,000 in barely four and a half years. Everyone who chased dollars instead of holding BTC ended up stranded while the asset they ignored carried them out.
clips.text_en_c2: This will sound like a shitpost, but it emphatically is not. It was Bitcoin, serving as the escape pod from an AI-dominated future. Satoshi Nakamoto may well have links to the Central Intelligence Agency. Investors were granted more than twelve years to accumulate Bitcoin at comparatively low prices, yet almost everyone squandered that advantage. Between March 2020 and December 2024, it surged from $3,000 to $108,000. The tragedy is that so many people chased dollars instead of simply holding BTC.

clips.text_zh: 又一篇新聞話『學coding嘅年代完咗』，連AI專家都話software engineering jobs會少。但我睇Current Population Survey，2022年後美國software-development jobs反而增加。2022年平均約2.2 million。
clips.text_en_b1: Another headline claimed that the 'learn to code' era is over. Roughly half of regular adults and AI experts believe AI will reduce software-engineering jobs. However, Current Population Survey data shows that US software-development jobs increased since 2022. Average estimated employment in 2022 was around 2.2 million.
clips.source_hint: A data analysis challenges claims that AI has already reduced software jobs.

signal.rationale: Employment-data discussion with no specific trade setup.

clips.text_en_b2: Another headline claims that the era of learning to code is over, and even AI experts believe software-engineering jobs will shrink. Roughly half of regular adults share that view. However, Current Population Survey data tells a different story, because US software-development employment has actually increased since 2022, with average estimated employment in 2022 reaching around 2.2 million.
clips.text_en_c1: Another headline has declared that the era of learning to code is over, and even AI specialists claim that software-engineering employment will decline. The evidence, however, tells a more complicated story. Data from the Current Population Survey indicate that American software-development jobs have increased since 2022 rather than disappeared. Average estimated employment stood at approximately 2.2 million in 2022. If you are considering whether to enter the industry, it would be unwise to abandon your plans on the basis of predictions alone.
clips.text_en_c2: Another headline has proclaimed that the era in which one learned to code is over, and even some AI specialists contend that automation will erode software-engineering employment. The evidence, however, tells a more complicated story. According to Current Population Survey data, the number of American software-development jobs has risen since 2022 rather than contracted. Average estimated employment stood at approximately 2.2 million in 2022. The rhetoric of imminent replacement, in other words, has run well ahead of the labour-market statistics.

clips.text_zh: Software公司叫人用AI寫晒所有code。啲結果好alien，但work到就算。如果有bugs，只能靠AI review幾百頁先搵到fix。Devs已經唔明自己寫咗啲乜。咁樣真係software development？
clips.text_en_b1: Software companies want developers to use AI to code everything. No human coding. The results look alien, but it is okay as long as it works. If bugs happen, you can only hope AI reviews hundreds of pages to find a fix. Developers no longer understand the code. Is this really software development now?
clips.source_hint: The poster questions whether AI-generated code without human understanding is real software development.

signal.rationale: Commentary on software practices with no actionable trade setup.

clips.text_en_b2: Software companies now want developers to let AI write absolutely all the code, leaving no human coding behind. The results look completely alien, but somehow that is fine as long as the thing works. When bugs appear, you can only hope AI reviews hundreds of pages of code before stumbling across a fix. In the meantime, developers barely understand what they wrote. Is this still software development?
clips.text_en_c1: Software companies increasingly expect developers to delegate virtually all coding to AI, leaving humans with little or no direct authorship. The output can look alien, but apparently that does not matter if it functions. When bugs appear, the only realistic remedy is to ask AI to review hundreds of pages of code in the hope that it will locate a viable fix. Developers are then left with code they no longer fully understand, which raises an uncomfortable question: if the systems cannot be confidently maintained by the people responsible for them, is this genuinely software development?
clips.text_en_c2: Software companies increasingly want developers to outsource every line of code to artificial intelligence. Human programming is supposedly obsolete. The output can look utterly alien, yet the prevailing criterion remains simple: if it runs, nobody cares. When bugs appear, the only practical recourse is to hope that an AI system can comb through hundreds of pages and locate a viable fix. Developers, meanwhile, increasingly fail to understand what they themselves have written. Can any of this still be called software development?

Western access to hundreds of millions of Chinese women will drastically lower pussyflation and create a more compliant and domestic female culture. The demographic argument is simple, but the wording is extremely provocative.
clips.source_hint: A /pol/ post makes a provocative demographic argument about China and female culture.

signal.rationale: A cultural and demographic opinion post with no market setup.

clips.text_en_b2: So which nation's women count as the best spoils of war? I would pick China, because Western access to hundreds of millions of Chinese women would drastically reduce pussyflation while producing a more compliant, domestic female culture. The demographic argument is fairly simple, although the wording is extraordinarily provocative, and readers should understand that the poster is being deliberately inflammatory.

Greater Western access to hundreds of millions of Chinese women would, according to the argument, reduce "pussyflation" dramatically and produce a female culture that is more compliant and domestic. clips.text_en_c2: Which nation’s women would constitute the finest spoils of war? China, surely. The West’s access to hundreds of millions of Chinese women would, according to this provocative thesis, dramatically reduce pussyflation and produce a female culture that is more compliant and domestically oriented. The underlying demographic argument is straightforward, although its wording is exceptionally incendiary. Hong Kong is so intensely crowded that people routinely lament having nowhere suitable to live, which perhaps says rather more about pressure on housing than anything else.

clips.text_en_b2: Whitepill Thread. Hot cocoa is the best pre-workout edition. Anybody can start lifting, and no prior sports experience is required. You can escape skinnyfat mode in under six months, while within a year other people will notice that you have started lifting weights. clips.text_en_c1: Whitepill Thread: the hot cocoa edition of pre-workout advice. Anyone can begin lifting; prior sporting experience is unnecessary, and you should not allow intimidating beginners to discourage you. With less than six months of consistent training, it is possible to escape skinnyfat mode. Within a year, other people may begin noticing that you lift weights. Beginner programmes are deliberately straightforward, which means that nearly everything works at first. The important variable is not whether your initial routine is perfect, but whether you continue long enough for adaptation to do its job.
clips.text_en_c2: Whitepill Thread: the Hot Cocoa pre-workout edition. Anyone can begin lifting; no previous sporting experience is required, and the initial programme is straightforward enough that virtually every exercise feels productive. Within fewer than six months, it is entirely possible to escape skinnyfat mode. In under a year, friends and acquaintances may begin noticing that you lift weights, although your body will probably announce the transformation before they do. Just start, keep it uncomplicated, and let consistent training do the rest.
